question: A alone can do a piece of work in 10 days. B alone can do the same work in 12 days. They work on alternate days starting with A. In how many days will days will they complete (3)/(4) of the total work?
solution:
Given:

Time taken by A to do a work = 10 days 

Time taken by B to do the same work = 12 days 

Calculations:

Total work 

= LCM(10, 12)

= 60

Efficiency of A = 60/10 = 6

Efficiency of B 

= 60/12 = 5

So, work done in 2 alternate days = 6 + 5 = 11

Now, 3/4 of total work= 60 × 3/4

= 45

Now, Time taken to complete 44 work = 44/11 = 4 pair = 4 × 2 = 8 days

And the next day A wil work again to complete the remaining 1unit work = 1/6

Hence Total time= 8 + 1/6

**Hence, The time taken by A and B working alternatively to complete the work is (49)/(6)days.**
